slots.text: Gathers force gradually, reaching its peak around the sunset ritual.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Cavo Paradiso
slots.text: The cliffside open-air club above Paradise Beach, booking international DJs since 1993.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Jackie O' Beach Club
slots.text: Carries a poolside lunch into early-evening drag.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: The Garden
slots.text: On a hillside property that Yehudi Menuhin acquired after visiting in 1962; the music stays low enough for conversation.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Lío
slots.text: The full-night choice: an à la carte meal built around modern cabaret before becoming a club at 12:30 a.m.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: A sunrise run through the city
slots.text: A 5 or 10K running tour with Running in Morocco takes in the kasbah walls, Bab Agnaou and the Mamounia gates, adapted to your pace.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: The medina with a cultural guide
slots.text: Walk with Najat Noudari past breadmakers, blacksmiths, weavers and tanners, and landmarks like the Koutoubia Mosque and the Saadian Tombs.
slots.food: Lunch at La Table du Souk: prawn green salads and barbecue sea bass.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Odette Rooftop Bar
slots.text: A mezze menu of Moroccan ingredients with global flair, such as crispy sheep cheese cigars, and cocktails like Rock the Kasbah.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: A hot-air balloon at sunrise
slots.text: Drift above olive groves, desert ridges and Berber villages with Atlas Montgolfière, then land for a traditional desert-camp breakfast.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Bahia Palace and Dar Si Said
slots.text: A 19th-century marvel of painted ceilings and sculpted gardens, then a former palace holding Morocco's richest wood carvings and textiles.
slots.food: Lunch at Terrasse des Épices, or Zeitoun Cafe for lamb tagine and harira.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: El Fenn rooftop
slots.text: A design oasis beside the Koutoubia Mosque, pouring outstanding drinks like the El Pacha and cooking amazing meat and fish.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Jardin Majorelle
slots.text: Dreamed up in the 1920s by Jacques Majorelle and restored by Yves Saint Laurent and Pierre Bergé: a two-and-a-half-acre oasis in Majorelle Blue.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Yves Saint Laurent Museum
slots.text: Africa's first fashion museum, next door; book the combined ticket in advance.
slots.food: Post-museum lounging on the sun-drenched terrace café.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: A Royal Hammam
slots.text: La Sultana's Royal Hammam Signature treatment: a black-soap exfoliation, a body mask and gentle stretching.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: A local-led food tour
slots.text: Sample bun cha, bo la lot and endless varieties of che, sitting streetside on plastic stools.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Hoan Kiem Lake
slots.text: The Lake of the Returned Sword: stroll to the scarlet Huc Bridge and Ngoc Son Temple, a 19th-century shrine.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: The Alchemist and Beer Street
slots.text: A drink at speakeasy-style The Alchemist, then Ta Hien Street, nicknamed Beer Street, and Polite & Co.
slots.food: Dinner at Gia or Home Hanoi for elevated northern Vietnamese cuisine.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Su Quan Roastery
slots.text: A roughly two-hour workshop on traditional Vietnamese coffee, and turning it into egg coffee or coconut coffee.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Temple of Literature
slots.text: Vietnam's first university, founded in 1070, then the 11th-century Quan Thanh Temple.
slots.food: Lunch at Binh Banh My, a local recommendation.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Tran Quoc Pagoda
slots.text: The city's oldest Buddhist shrine, on West Lake, with scarlet towers that make a picture-perfect sunset.
slots.food: Dinner at Pho Suong: a cash-only stall famous for beef pho.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Hoa Lo Prison
slots.text: Nicknamed the Hanoi Hilton, where Vietnamese revolutionaries and U.S. POWs were imprisoned.
slots.food: Breakfast: coffee and banh mi in the Old Quarter.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
slots.text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site that was the political heart of Vietnam for more than a millennium.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Train Street
slots.text: Cafés and homes sit inches from a 19th-century railway; night trains typically pass around 7 and 9.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: An architecture walk in Brera
slots.text: A Context Travel tour of Milan's most important buildings, with a peek into vintage couture shop Cavalli e Nastri.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Pinacoteca di Brera
slots.text: An impressive Renaissance gallery, home to the 250-plus-year-old Accademia di Belle Arti di Brera.
slots.food: Aperitivo in the garden of Bvlgari Hotel Milan's Il Bar.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Voce Aimo e Nadia
slots.text: Dinner in the Galleria d'Italia, with changing tasting menus designed around the adjacent gallery's displays.
slots.food: Milan's iconic saffron risotto.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Triennale Milano
slots.text: Milan's design museum, with the newly opened Museo del Design Italiano permanent exhibit.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Fondazione Prada
slots.text: A sprawling 200,000-square-foot contemporary art complex with a nine-story tower and Wes Anderson's Bar Luce.
slots.food: Lunch at Terrazza Triennale: cacio e pepe and costoletta alla milanese.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Nebbia
slots.text: Part of a new generation of trattorias, with innovative takes on regional recipes in a minimalist space.
slots.food: Roasted pumpkin with goat milk and sesame, and a semifreddo dessert.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Via Montenapoleone
slots.text: One of Europe's most expensive shopping streets, then Via Spiga and Nilufar Gallery, a top design dealer.
slots.food: Breakfast at Pasticceria Cova: a cappuccino and pastry beneath chandeliers.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Maroncelli and 10 Corso Como
slots.text: The Maroncelli District is the latest enclave of boutiques, galleries and studios, near the 10 Corso Como concept store.
slots.food: Lunch at AMOR: the Alajmo brothers' patented steamed pizza.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Piazza del Duomo
slots.text: A gothic cathedral with 3,400 statues, beside Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and its boutiques.
slots.food: A spritz on the Terrazza Aperol.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque
slots.text: Over 90 acres, with a 164-foot central dome, a Swarovski chandelier and the world's second-largest carpet.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Mutrah Souq
slots.text: A traditional market built in the 1820s, with labyrinthine lanes for frankincense and khanjar, then the nearly two-mile Mutrah Corniche.
slots.food: A cup of karak, and Omani halwa with cardamom and saffron.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Royal Opera House Muscat
slots.text: A guided tour of Islamic, Mughal, Oriental and European influences, with rare instruments and landscaped gardens.
slots.food: Dinner at Hakkasan: contemporary Cantonese, starting with the Supreme dim sum.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: The Damaniyat Islands
slots.text: A 40-minute speedboat from Al Mouj Marina to nine limestone islands and coral reefs, a nature reserve ideal for snorkeling.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Guerlain Spa
slots.text: At The St. Regis Al Mouj: arrive early for the sauna and hammam, then an Imperial Relaxing Massage on a heated bed.
slots.food: Lunch at Zorba: breezy Greek food with sea vistas.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Coya
slots.text: Incan-heritage-inspired interiors and modern Peruvian food, best enjoyed family-style.
slots.food: The ceviche platter, prawn and sea bass gyoza, and tres leches cake.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Nizwa Fort
slots.text: Built over 12 years in the 17th century, with the largest circular tower in the region and notches for pouring hot date syrup on invaders.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Nizwa Souq
slots.text: Thought to date to the 3rd century, selling frankincense, silver jewelry, khanjar and pottery. Bargaining is expected.
slots.food: Lunch at Liwan Nizwa: rice with curried fish and grilled seafood.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Roberto's
slots.text: Contemporary Italian seafood at the hotel, starting with a frankincense-infused Spritz My Way.
slots.food: Slow-roasted octopus, and a pistachio ice cream with olive oil.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Midosuji Avenue
slots.text: Considered the Champs-Élysées of Osaka, and a favourite of travellers who like luxury shops.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Afternoon tea at The St. Regis Osaka
slots.text: On the 12th-floor rooftop Zen garden, with a seasonal Japanese sake garden.
slots.food: A traditional afternoon tea service, and the signature champagne sabrage at dusk.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Dotonbori
slots.text: A district that buzzes at all hours, with the famous Glico man advertisement, then Shinsaibashi's covered arcade.
slots.food: Okonomiyaki at Okonomiyaki Mizuno, crab at Kani Doraku or kitsune udon at Dotonbori Imai Honten.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Osaka Castle
slots.text: A reconstruction of the original with a museum-style attraction inside; book tickets online to skip the line.
slots.food: Breakfast at The St. Regis Osaka: a Japanese tray of soy-glazed fish, rice and tofu.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Sumiyoshi Taisha
slots.text: One of the oldest Shinto shrines in Japan, founded in the third century, with the iconic Sorihashi Bridge.
slots.food: Or catch a bunraku show at the National Bunraku Theatre.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Teppanyaki Wajo
slots.text: A high-end grill with seafood from the Seto Inland Sea and beef from Kobe, led by a chef who apprenticed under Joël Robuchon.
slots.food: Finish with a matcha green tea service.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Kuromon Market
slots.text: Dating back hundreds of years, with fresh seafood and meat, grilled seafood and yakitori skewers.
slots.food: Don't miss the takoyaki, round savory bites usually filled with octopus.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: A day trip to Nara
slots.text: Pay respect to the almost 50-foot bronze Buddha at Tōdai-ji, among the many deer roaming local sites.
slots.food: Kyoto, under an hour by train, is the other option.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Kobe beef
slots.text: Kobe is the day trip for foodies, with many excellent restaurants serving the region's marbled beef.
